captures.what_is_new: Web Summit's blog lists a post 'Important event update', 10 Nov 2026 (1 min read). Its excerpt, as recorded by the weather desk: the Government of Portugal has formally advised Web Summit that, due to risks from Storm Charles including tidal flooding, severe disruption to public transport and high winds on external structures, Day 2 should not take place, after discussions with the Portuguese Government and the national emergency authorities. The post's own address returned 404 when tried at 20:50 UTC.

story_candidates.title: Update: Wednesday's Web Summit events will not take place
story_candidates.angle: An update to the published Wednesday 11 November guide: Web Summit says the government formally advised that Day 2 should not take place because of Storm Charles. Readers who planned Wednesday's sessions need to see it at the top.
story_candidates.note: Ready as an UPDATE (a note at the top) to wednesday-11-november-going-abroad, not a new article; time-sensitive. Conditions: attribute to Web Summit's post and quote only what the public excerpt says; say the post's own page did not open when checked; say nothing about Thursday or what attendees should do beyond what Web Summit publishes; side events by other organisers are not covered by Web Summit's notice, say that their organisers announce their own; re-read the blog before publishing. Publication needs approval through reviewer@PrompTugal.vicky.
